text_block_list.text:
Noticing Mihono Bourbon's gloomy 
expression, I called out to her with 
concern—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master, thank you for your concern. I was 
apprehensive about skin abnormalities.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"However, that is not an issue. We can 
simply replace this skin... or rather, 
these skin parts to resolve it."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
............My apologies. That was a 
joke—a "robo-joke," in other words.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I intended to tell a joke so as not to 
cause Master worry... but I have failed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Bad status "Misfortunes Never Come Singly" 
confirmed. The root cause of it all is... 
determined to be... skin trouble...

Mihono Bourbon found that everything was 
going wrong all because of her rough 
skin...
